rules.title: Townhall current HP is always within 0..500
Townhall maximum HP is always 500 across fixtures and Unity HUD
wall_max strictly equals 1000 + 200 * (wall_tier - 1)
Wall current HP is always within 0..wall_max
Village level is within 1..50 and matches total_wins formula
Wall tier is always within 1..20
Resources (wood, stone, food) remain within 0..1,000,000
WAITING state consistently uses wave_tick = -1 and P = 0
Phase derivation matches [-1=waiting, 0..1599=prep, 1600..2599=assault, 2600..2799=finale, 2800..2999=results]
Voting opens only on even waves during ticks 800..1199 and locks at 1200
Vote A/B/C costs, effects, localization, and one-time tick-1200 deduction match ttg-rules-v1
Initial three-lane HP (34%/32%/rem) and runner/grunt/brute subpools (25%/55%/rem) follow ttg-rules-v1
Boss max HP strictly equals ceil(base_hp / 5) and never uses cinematic 1800 pools
Boss does not exist and has 0 authoritative HP prior to tick 2600
Boss spawns/incoming occurs exclusively on every fifth wave (wave_no % 5 == 0)
Wave settlement result is never emitted before tick 2800 and always present in 2800..2999
Ordinary and Boss HP decrease monotonically after spawn; visual units are decorative proxies
Settlement executes once at tick 2800 with exact +100W/+60S/+50F rewards and zero RESULTS repair
Role counts sum to unique_joined and militia bonus equals max(0, 40 - 4*(P-1)) for 1<=P<=10
Registrations during RESULTS stay queued for Wave+1 and promote cleanly at tick 3000 rollover
Wall tier upgrades obey 200*tier work and 100*tier stone thresholds at 200-tick boundaries
Backpressure vs drops, synthetic watermarks, and Music PENDING_REVIEW mute (-80 dB) remain truthful
All 12 GPU-rendered Unity HUD states derive 100% of counters from SyntheticCommittedView fixtures
Timeline durations, SHA-256 provenance, 1% low FPS math, GC profiler counters, and README figures agree
Fixtures explicitly mark M05 WS schema as NOT_STARTED synthetic views and enforce <= 300 session XP cap
